column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_cardalbum.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Album frame draw: clears layer 0 to black; unless the album state 0x0000c310 is 0 or 8, either (card viewer flag 0x0000debc clear) draws the background, the 3D setup, the cover and the pages, then on layer 4 the header, footer, the cursor arrow in browse state 3, the card detail panel (ui_draw_card_detail_view_temp with the block 0x0000dec0) and the index menu in state 5, then the fade on layer 5; or (viewer active) ui_card_viewer_draw and the zoom view. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE and font commands. Exported (libcardalbum_rel); called from rel_story (world_state_update_card_album) and rel_title (ui_title_draw_card_album).

When resource 0x1001 (a GIM) is available, draws it as seven 64 x 256 strips and one 32 x 256 strip across the top 256 lines and eight rotated 16 x 64 strips (texels from x 0x1e0 and 0x1f0) for the bottom 16 lines. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_draw).

Draws the animated 32 x 32 cursor sprite from resource 0x1003 (frame from the 10-byte table 0x0000ba50 indexed by (frame timer >> 2) % 10): in zone 2 (cursor byte 0x0000dea4 bits 0-1) at x = halfword table 0x0000ba44[menu item], y 0xf0; in zone 1 at x 0x96 or 0x1b8 (mirrored on the left), y 200; in zone 0 at the cell position from the 8-byte table 0x0000b9b4/0x0000b9b8. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_draw, state 3).

Draws the header bar from resource 0x1002 (three pieces at x 0x91..0x1e0), the title (dictionary word 7 of string table resource 0x1030) at (0x96, 4), word 2 right-aligned before the percentage, a '%' sign and the completion value 0x0000de9e (permille) as tens and units with a '.' and one decimal, or 100 when it reaches 1000. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_draw).

column2: void ui_list_window_draw_text(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Same code as BOOT ui_list_window_draw_text: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Returns nothing. Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 3 (ui_album_draw_footer, ui_album_draw_header, ui_album_draw_number).

column2: void ui_window_draw_text_px(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Same code as BOOT ui_window_draw_text_px: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text) with text passed through in its register. Returns nothing. Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 2 (ui_album_draw_header, ui_album_draw_zoom_overlay).

Draws the ehf resource 0x1010 (menu bar animation) at the current frame timer, then for the left/right page under the cursor (ui_album_get_cursor_page) the page number and page count as "n/m" at y 0xf7 (pages of 18 slots over 0x0000c31c), or dictionary word 3 centred for the special page beyond them. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_draw).

column2: void * ui_album_draw_number(void *list, short x, short y, int value, short step)
column3: Draws value in decimal right-aligned ending at x - step, one digit character per step pixels going left, with ui_list_window_draw_text inside an external font list. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: font commands. Callers: 2 (ui_album_draw_footer, ui_album_draw_header).

Zoom viewer overlay: alpha = 0x0000e964 * 0xff / 10; draws icons from resource 0x100e (corner pieces, button glyphs at (0xb, 0xb0), (0x15, 0xea), (0x1ba, 0xbb)) and dictionary words 6 (both top corners), 4, 9 (left, centred on x 0x1d) and 5 (right) at scale 12. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE and font commands. Callers: 1 (ui_album_draw_zoom_view).

When the zoom viewer is active (0x0000def8), on layer 4 darkens the screen with alpha 0x0000e964 * 20, and once the art is decoded (flag bit 1 of 0x0000def9) binds the 512 x 512 RGBA buffer 0x0000defc as texture, builds a 9 x 9 grid of vertices (u, v, x, y, z) scaled by the zoom 0x0000df08 + 0x200, rotated by 0x0000df0c (system_vfpu_matrix3_rot_z) and offset by the pan 0x0000df00/0x0000df04 + screen centre into one of two vertex buffers at 0x0000df20 (double-buffered by bit 2 of 0x0000def9) and draws 8 triangle strips of 18 indices (0x0000e940) with system_gum_draw_array; then the overlay. VFPU code read from the Ghidra pseudo-ops; lower confidence. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands, vertex buffers. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_draw).

Opens the index (jump) menu: allocates card_db_get_top_count() bytes at 0x0000c274 and marks the letter group (card_db_get_top_group) of every owned slot; selects the letter layout table 0x0000ba64 (10 x 5, language 0) or 0x0000ba98 (7 x 4); flags a special row when slots exist beyond the owned list; allocates and fills a 0x120-byte list window (size from the layout, title word 8, draw callback ui_album_draw_jump_menu_items at +0x100) and opens it; album state 5. Frees everything on allocation failure. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap, window, state. Callers: 1 (ui_album_update_browse).

Frees the presence array 0x0000c274 and the window 0x0000c284 from the album heap and clears both pointers. Returns nothing. Side effects: frees memory. Callers: 2 (ui_album_open_jump_menu, ui_album_update_jump_menu).

Index menu update (state 5): runs ui_update_list_window; when the window reports state 6 (closed) returns to state 3 and, unless cancelled, jumps (ui_album_jump_to_slot) to the first slot of the chosen letter group (ui_album_find_group_start) or to the first special slot, then frees the menu. While open (window state 3): d-pad moves the cursor 0x0000c272 (column in bits 0-3, row in bits 4-7, special row flag 0x0000c273) with wrap and plays the cursor sound; confirm on a present group or the special row chooses item 0 (sound 0x7a05); cancel marks it cancelled and starts closing (0x7a06). Returns nothing. Side effects: window, state, cursor. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_update).
Draws the index menu window 0x0000c284 with ui_draw_list_window. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_draw).

column2: void ui_album_draw_jump_menu_items(void *list, int x, int y, int width)
column3: List-window draw callback of the index menu: draws the cursor frame (22 x 22 on a letter, or 0x4e wide on the special row), then each letter of the layout (card_db_get_top_letter) centred in a 22-pixel cell, black when the group has owned cards and half-transparent otherwise; the Japanese layout leaves a gap column after half the columns; the special row shows word 3. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE and font commands. No direct caller (callback stored at window +0x100 by ui_album_open_jump_menu).

column2: void ui_album_draw_text_to_edge(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Same code as ui_list_window_draw_text: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Returns nothing. Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (ui_album_draw_jump_menu_items).
Returns the first slot below 0x0000c31c holding a card whose card_db_get_top_group equals group, or 0x0000c31c when none. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_album_update_jump_menu).

One-time render setup on layer 0: viewport, scissor, depth, culling, alpha test, colour, field_3d_init_render_state, installs ui_album_heap_alloc/free as the field_3d allocator, clears the 0x3c-byte light block 0x0000c288 (ambient 0xff000000, diffuse white, position from 0x0000bab4), lighting with light 0, ambient 0xff333333, material, specular 10, fog, perspective (0x0000b92c, 0x0000b928, 10, 40), clear colour 0xff770000, texture scale (1, -1) and 8 identity bone matrices. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands, field_3d allocator. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_start).
Same code as BOOT field_3d_copy_vec3: copies three floats from src to dest. Returns dest. Side effects: writes dest. Callers: 1 (ui_album_init_render).

Per-frame 3D setup on layer 1: light 0 from 0x0000c288, lighting, ambient, viewport and raster state, fog; projection = translation (0x0000bac0 + cover offset 0x0000dea0, 0x0000bac4, 0x0000bac8) times perspective (near 10, far 40); camera look-at with eye 0x0000bad0, target 0x0000bae0, up 0x0000baf0; identity model matrix. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands, gum matrices. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_draw).

Starts opening the album: cover state (bits 2-3 of 0x0000c314) = 1, cover model 0x1020 frame 0, frees all pages and creates pages 0, 1 and 2 at positions 4, 5 and 6 with animation kind 3. Returns nothing. Side effects: page list, model state. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_update, state 1).

column2: void ui_album_set_page_anim(float speed, void *page, int kind)
column3: Sets a page's animation kind: copies the 0x68-byte template model (resource from the 16-byte table 0x0000bb00[kind]; 0x1022 is replaced by 0x1023 on pages beyond the owned list) into page+0x40, builds a group mask hiding empty card slots (bit 11 + n for slots 0-8, 12 + n for 9-17) and, for kinds 1 and 2, slots whose card_db_cip_query_image_state is 0, installs ui_album_card_texture_hook as draw state 0, sets the start frame (+0x60) from the table and the speed (+0xa8 = speed, or 0 when start and end frames are equal) and stores kind in the low nibble of byte +0. Returns nothing. Side effects: page object. Callers: 4 (ui_album_draw_page, ui_album_flip_backward, ui_album_flip_forward, ui_album_create_page).

Updates (step 1.0 while animating) and draws the cover model 0x1020; cover state 1 moves the camera offset 0x0000dea0 by 0x0000b924 per frame until frame 14, then state 2 (held at frame 14); state 3 moves it back by 0x0000b920 until frame 30, then state 0. Returns nothing. Side effects: model state, 0x0000dea0, 0x0000c314. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_draw).

Draws every page of the list 0x0000c318 whose animation kind is not 0 or 7 (ui_album_draw_page) and, in browse state 3, the cell cursor for the cell in 0x0000dea4. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands, page state. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_draw).

Translates to the page position (+0x28..+0x30), advances the model by its speed (+0xa8) and draws it; when the frame (+0x60) passes the end frame of its kind (0x0000bb08[kind]) shifts all page positions (kind 5: ui_album_shift_pages_up, kind 4: ui_album_shift_pages_down) and switches the page to the next kind from the table byte 0x0000bb0c[kind]. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands, page list. Callers: 1 (ui_album_draw_pages).
Draws the cursor model 0x1024 (flag bit 1 of +0x3c set) translated to the cell position (0x0000bb80 + cell * 8: x, z). Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_album_draw_pages).

Allocates from the album heap 0x0000dee0 (tail call hidden by the decompiler; hypothesis, confidence medium from its use as the field_3d allocator). Returns the block. Side effects: heap allocation. No direct caller (installed by ui_album_init_render).

Frees ptr from the album heap 0x0000dee0 (tail call hidden; same code shape as BOOT audio_heap_free with the module's heap). Returns the free result. Side effects: heap release. No direct caller (installed by ui_album_init_render).

column2: int ui_album_card_texture_hook(void **list_ptr, int unused, int part, int unused2, void *hook)
column3: Model draw-state hook: for model parts 0x12..0x23 takes the card id of page slot part - 0x12 (page pointer at hook+0x30); when card_db_cip_query_image_state(cardm reader, card, artwork) is 0 writes the art texture with card_db_cip_write_image_texture; if no art was written, shows placeholder resource 0x100c or 0x100d on alternate phases of (frame timer >> 2) % 3 (third phase: not handled); sets texture function, offset (0, 1) and scale (1, -1) and stores the list. Returns 1 when the part was handled, 0 otherwise. Side effects: GE commands, card art loads. No direct caller (installed by ui_album_set_page_anim).

Builds the album card list (ui_album_build_card_list), sets the menu animation range 8 and resets the auto-repeat button 0x0000dea8 and the flip speeds 0x0000deac/0x0000deb0 to 1.0. Returns nothing. Side effects: album lists, ehf state. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_update, state 0).

Browse state 3: the analog stick Y (pad +0x14 outside 0x40..0xc0) scrolls the detail text 0x0000dec8 (clamped to 0x0000decc); cancel sets state 8 (0x7a06); triangle opens the index menu (0x7a08); L flips backward and R forward (auto-repeat button 0x100/0x200, sound 0x7a0d); otherwise dispatches to the cell, arrow or menu cursor by zone; always updates the flip auto-repeat. Returns nothing. Side effects: album state, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_update).

Cell cursor (zone 0, cell = column 0-5 + row 0-2 * 6 in bits 2-7 of 0x0000dea4): left at column 0 / right at column 5 move to the left / right arrow (zone 1), up stops at row 0, down past row 2 moves to the menu (zone 2) with the menu item = column; stores the cell, fixes the page side, refreshes the detail card; confirm on a non-empty card sets state 6 (0x7a05); square moves to the menu. Returns nothing. Side effects: cursor bytes, state, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_album_update_browse).

Arrow zone: left on the left arrow flips backward (auto-repeat 0x80), right on the right arrow flips forward (0x20), the other directions return to the grid; up returns to the grid; down goes to the menu (item 0 or 5); confirm flips toward the selected arrow with the confirm button as auto-repeat key. Returns nothing. Side effects: cursor, page flips, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_album_update_browse).

Menu zone: left/right cycle the 6 items (low nibble of 0x0000dea5); up or square returns to the grid with menu animation 7; confirm (0x7a05) runs item 0 jump to slot 0, 1 previous letter group, 2 flip backward, 3 flip forward, 4 next letter group, 5 last slot, then plays that item's menu animation when a flip started. Returns nothing. Side effects: cursor, jumps, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_album_update_browse).

In browse state with pages present: clears the preload queue and walks the pages from the last to the first, queuing each card id of pages animating with kind 2 (front side, forward order) or kind 1 (back side, reverse order) once per cell; then uploads one queued texture (ui_album_upload_preload) and services the menu animation range (0x00005074). Returns nothing. Side effects: preload queue, card art loads. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_update).

Returns the page object at position 3 when the cursor column is 0-2, else at position 4 (ui_album_find_page). No side effects. Callers: 4 (ui_album_draw_footer, ui_album_get_cursor_card, ui_album_get_cursor_slot, ui_album_fix_cursor_side).

Returns the card id under the cell cursor: left page (columns 0-2) uses entry row * 3 + 9 + column, right page uses (row - 1) * 3 + column (entries 0-8); 0 when no page. No side effects. Callers: 4 (ui_album_update_card_viewer, ui_album_update_grid_cursor, ui_album_refresh_detail_card, ui_album_zoom_begin).
Returns the album slot under the cursor: entry (as in ui_album_get_cursor_card) + page number (+2, 15 bits) * 18; 0 when no page. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_album_find_adjacent_group).

When the card under the cursor is non-zero and differs from the detail-view card 0x0000dec0, stores it and resets the text scroll 0x0000dec8. Returns 1 when changed, else 0. Side effects: writes 0x0000dec0/0x0000dec8. Callers: 3 (ui_album_update_grid_cursor, ui_album_update_arrow_cursor, ui_album_update_menu_cursor).

Finds the page at position 3, starts its flip with animation kind 5 at speed, moves it to the end of the page list and sets album state 4; then, if the lowest occupied position is 1 and its page number is above 0, creates the previous page at position 0 with kind 1. Returns nothing. Side effects: page list, state. Callers: 5 (ui_album_update_flip, ui_album_update_arrow_cursor, ui_album_update_menu_cursor, ui_album_update_browse, ...).

Finds the page at position 4, starts its flip with animation kind 4 at speed, moves it to the end of the list and sets state 4; then, if the highest occupied position is 6 and a following page exists, creates it at position 7 with kind 2. Returns nothing. Side effects: page list, state. Callers: 5 (ui_album_update_flip, ui_album_update_arrow_cursor, ui_album_update_menu_cursor, ui_album_update_browse, ...).

Flip state 4: updates the auto-repeat speeds; during a jump (bit 0 of 0x0000deb4) confirm rebuilds the pages directly around the target page 0x0000deb6 and ends the jump, cancel ends it. Sets the speed of flipping pages (kind 5 / 4) from 0x0000deb0 / 0x0000deac unless jumping, and slides the other pages by the flipping page's speed (0x0000b988/0x0000b98c scaled by speed / 25). When no page is flipping: without a jump returns to state 3; with a jump continues flipping toward the target at 0x0000deb8 or, on arrival, sets the cursor cell from the jump target and returns to state 3. Returns nothing. Side effects: page list and positions, state, sounds. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_update).
Binary search of card_id in the 16 sorted u16 ids at 0x0000bc10. Returns 1 when found, else 0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_album_build_card_list).

column2: int ui_album_place_special_card(short *special, int card_id, int count)
column3: Stores a special card at its fixed index of the special page: 0x1386 at 0, 0x1387 at 1, 0x1388 at 2, 0xecd at 3, 0xea8 at 4, 0x1ca4..0x1cac at 5..13, 0x1cad at 14, 0x1b4d at 15; other ids are ignored. Returns the new used count (max of count and index + 1). Side effects: writes special[index]. Callers: 1 (ui_album_build_card_list).

Orders the card ids 0xe88..0x1f39 by card_db_get_sort_position into a stack table, then fills the slot array 0x0000c320 (cleared, 0x1b5a bytes) with every valid, non-token, non-special card in that order: its id when save_get_card_state is non-zero, else 0 (an empty slot). Owned special cards go to the 16-entry special list. Stores the slot count in 0x0000c31c and the completion owned * 1000 / slots in 0x0000de9e; appends the special list after rounding the slots up to whole 18-slot pages and stores the total in 0x0000c31e. Returns nothing. Side effects: album lists. Callers: 1 (ui_album_prepare).

Moves the cursor to slot (page = slot / 18; entries 0-8 on the right page, 9-17 on the left): when that page is already shown sets the cursor cell; otherwise records a jump (0x0000deb4 = target cell, 0x0000deb6 = page) and starts flipping toward it at speed 3.125, 6.25 or 12.5 for distances below 0x15, below 0x33 or more pages. Returns 1, or 0 when slot is out of range. Side effects: cursor, jump state, page flips. Callers: 2 (ui_album_update_menu_cursor, ui_album_update_jump_menu).

State 6, sub-state 0x0000c312: 0 starts a 16-frame black fade-out; 1 after the fade opens ui_card_viewer_open(cursor card, resource 0x1006, 0x1009), enables artwork selection, sets the pack source (resource 0x100a) and sets the viewer flag; 2 runs the zoom viewer (ui_album_zoom_update) or, when it is idle, ui_card_viewer_update until the viewer closes, then clears the flag and fades in; 3 after the fade returns to state 3. Returns nothing. Side effects: card viewer, fades, state. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_update).

Page-flip auto-repeat: when the recorded button 0x0000dea8 is released resets it and both speeds to 1.0; while it is held and newly repeated (pad word +0x0c) adds 0.5 (max 5.0) to the backward speed 0x0000deb0 (keys 0x80, 0x100) or forward speed 0x0000deac (0x20, 0x200), or for the confirm button to the speed of the selected arrow. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes the speeds. Callers: 2 (ui_album_update_flip, ui_album_update_browse).

When no page exists on the cursor's side, moves the cursor cell to the same row on the other page (column +3 or -3) when that page exists, leaving the arrow zone. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes 0x0000dea4. Callers: 3 (ui_album_update_flip, ui_album_update_grid_cursor, ui_album_jump_to_slot).

From the cursor slot, finds the first slot of the next letter group (backward 0) or the start of the previous group (backward 1) by comparing card_db_get_top_group of non-empty slots; slots past the owned list count as their own group. Returns the slot, or -1 when none or when it is the cursor slot. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_album_update_menu_cursor).

Sets the play range of the ehf resource 0x1010: item 8 frames 0..0, 7 frames 9..9, 6 frames 0..9, otherwise frames item * 5 + 10 .. item * 5 + 14 (highlight of menu item 0-5). Returns nothing. Side effects: ehf state. Callers: 3 (ui_card_album_update, ui_album_prepare, ui_album_update_menu_cursor).

When the EHF of resource 0x1010 (ui_album_get_resource) has a play range with end > 0 and its current frame has reached end - 1, sets the play range to (end - 1, end) so the layout stays on its last frame instead of looping. Returns nothing. Side effects: the EHF play range. Callers: 1 (ui_album_preload_textures).

First call: clears the 0xa84-byte zoom block 0x0000def8, fills the strip index table 0x0000e940 with pairs (n, n + 9) for n = 0..8, calls sceJpegInitMJpeg and sceJpegCreateMJpeg(512, 512), allocates 0x3e000 bytes and opens the cardj cip reader (card_db_open_cardj_cip, 0x0000e954) and returns 0. Later calls return 1 when the reader is ready. Side effects: JPEG library state, heap, reader. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_update, state 0).

First call: clears the init flag, frees the zoom buffer, sceJpegDeleteMJpeg, sceJpegFinishMJpeg, frees the reader buffer and requests the cardj reader to stop; returns 0. Later calls return 1 when the reader is idle. Side effects: JPEG library state, heap. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_update, state 8).

Starts the zoom viewer: state 1, allocates the 0x100000-byte RGBA buffer 0x0000defc, resets the decode stage, takes the cursor card (0x0000e95c) and its artwork (save_get_card_value_bits4_6, 0x0000e960), sets the start pan (-0xb5, -0x3b), zoom -0x1b2 and rotation 0, and fades the BGM to volume 0 over 600 frames when one is playing. Returns nothing. Side effects: heap, audio, zoom block. Callers: 1 (ui_album_zoom_update).
Clears the zoom state and the decoded flag and frees the RGBA buffer 0x0000defc. Returns nothing. Side effects: frees memory. Callers: 2 (ui_album_jpeg_term, ui_album_zoom_update).

Incremental full-size art decode. Stage 0 (after any BGM fade): card_db_cip_get_image(cardj reader, card, artwork) and card_db_cip_get_slot_bytes give the JPEG; sceJpegGetOutputInfo gives the output size, a 64-byte-aligned buffer is allocated and sceJpegDecodeMJpegYCbCr decodes into it; BGM volume 0x20 over 0x4b0 frames. Stage 1: converts 32 lines per call from the planar YCbCr output (Y 512 bytes per line, Cb at size * 4 / 6 and Cr at size * 5 / 6, one chroma byte per 2 x 2 pixels) to RGBA8888 rows of 0x800 bytes with the constants 0x0000b974..0x0000b984 (clamped 0..255, alpha 0); after 512 lines frees the YCbCr buffer and sets the decoded flag. Returns 1 when decoded, else 0. Side effects: heap, RGBA buffer, audio volume. Callers: 1 (ui_album_zoom_transition).

Zoom viewer state 0x0000def8: 0 starts (ui_album_zoom_begin) on confirm while ui_card_viewer_is_shown; 1 decodes while raising the overlay step 0x0000e964 to 10; 2 decodes and zooms in until done; 3 interactive: cancel saves the pose and goes to 4 (BGM back to 0x7f over 600 frames), analog Y zooms (step 4, -0x1e0..0x20), d-pad pans (step 2, +-0xf0 / +-0x88), L/R rotate by 0x0000b970 with wrap, triangle resets the pose; 4 zooms out and lowers the overlay; 5 frees and returns 0. Returns 1 while the zoom viewer is active, 0 when idle. Side effects: zoom block, audio. Callers: 1 (ui_album_update_card_viewer).

zoom_in 1: decodes a step (ui_album_zoom_decode) and, once decoded, eases pan and zoom over 10 steps (t = sin(0x0000b960 * step / 10)) from the card-sized pose to the full view (zoom -0x100); zoom_in 0: eases back from the saved pose (0x0000df10..0x0000df1c) to the card-sized pose. Returns 1 when the transition is complete, else 0. Side effects: zoom block. Callers: 1 (ui_album_zoom_update).

Clears the 0x26-byte loader block 0x0000c2d0 and sets it idle, then sorts the resource table 0x0000be88 (0x21 entries of 16 bytes) and the model table 0x0000c160 (5 entries of 0x14 bytes) by their u16 id with system_qsort and deck_compare_u16_ascending. Returns nothing. Side effects: writes the tables. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_start).

Resource loader step (stage in bits 1-7 of 0x0000c2d0, bit 0 idle): stage 0 allocates 0x6d000 bytes for the cardh cip reader (0x0000dee4) and 0x3f1000 bytes for the cardm cip reader (0x0000dee8) and starts the cardalbum.ehp load (the load callback advances the stage); 1 waits until both readers are ready; 2 opens ui_card_view_open with resources 0x1004, 0x1005, 0x1011, 0x1007, 0x1008 and the cardh reader and resets the detail card; 3 finishes. Returns 1 when finished, else 0. Side effects: heap, readers, file load, card view. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_update, state 0).

Frees the two reader buffers, destroys the 5 model instances of the table 0x0000c160 and frees the cardalbum.ehp buffer. Returns nothing. Side effects: frees memory. Callers: 1 (ui_album_shutdown_step).

Returns the cardalbum.ehp buffer 0x0000c2f8 when loaded; otherwise, when the loader is idle, allocates the file size and queues container_load_file(3, "database/cardalbum.ehp", buffer, size, shop_on_archive_loaded, buffer), and returns 0. Side effects: heap, asynchronous load. Callers: 3 (ui_album_resources_step, ui_album_get_resource, ui_album_get_model).

Looks id up in the resource table 0x0000be88 (16-byte entries {u16 id, void *cached, char *name_format, char *tmf_name}); when not cached and cardalbum.ehp is loaded, formats the member name with the language letter (6-letter table 0x0000c1dc indexed by save_get_language(); ids 0x1031/0x1032 use a fixed letter from 0x0000c1e4), finds the member, applies the tmf member's flags when one is named, and caches it. Returns the member, or 0. Side effects: cache. Callers: 12 (ui_album_update_card_viewer, ui_album_resources_step, ui_album_card_texture_hook, ui_album_draw_footer, ...).

Looks id up in the model table 0x0000c160 (0x14-byte entries {u16 id, instance, tms name, animation name, tma name}; ids 0x1020..0x1024, first tms album_cover00.tms); when not built and cardalbum.ehp is loaded, creates the model instance from the tms, attaching the animation member either as an animation list or, when it starts with the magic 0x544d4754 ("TGMT"), with field_3d_set_animation, and the tma member with field_3d_set_tma. Returns the instance, or 0. Side effects: model allocation. Callers: 4 (ui_album_set_page_anim, ui_album_draw_cell_cursor, ui_album_open_cover, ui_album_draw_cover).

column2: void * ui_album_create_page(uint position, int kind, int page_number)
column3: For a page number inside the album, allocates and clears a 0xc0-byte page object, inserts it into the list 0x0000c318 ordered by the z of its position (12-byte vec3 table 0x0000c1ec), stores the position in the high nibble of byte +0, a flag in +1, the 18 card ids of slots page_number * 18.. at +4 and the page number at +2, copies the position into +0x28..+0x30 and starts animation kind at speed 1.0 (ui_album_set_page_anim). Returns the page, or 0 when the page number is out of range. Side effects: heap, page list. Callers: 4 (ui_album_update_flip, ui_album_flip_backward, ui_album_open_cover, ui_album_flip_forward).

Clears the page list head 0x0000c318 and frees every page object from the album heap. Returns nothing. Side effects: frees memory. Callers: 3 (ui_album_shutdown_step, ui_album_open_cover, ui_album_update_flip).

After a forward flip: frees pages at positions 0-1 (unlinking them) and decrements the position of the others, then repositions all pages. Returns nothing. Side effects: page list, frees memory. Callers: 1 (ui_album_draw_page).

After a backward flip: frees pages at positions 6 and above and increments the position of the others, then repositions all pages. Returns nothing. Side effects: page list, frees memory. Callers: 1 (ui_album_draw_page).
Copies each page's position vector (+0x28..+0x30) from the table 0x0000c1ec[position]. Returns nothing. Side effects: page objects. Callers: 2 (ui_album_shift_pages_up, ui_album_shift_pages_down).

Returns the first page object of the list whose position nibble equals position, or 0. No side effects. Callers: 4 (ui_album_jump_to_slot, ui_album_update_flip, ui_album_get_cursor_page, ui_album_fix_cursor_side).
Returns 0. No side effects. No direct caller and no pointer to it in the module image (neither a jal/j nor a data word; hypothesis: an unused stub like shop_password_return_zero, confidence medium).

Album start: clears the 0x266c-byte state from 0x0000c310, stores mode in bits 0-1 of 0x0000c314; when heap is 0 creates a 10 MB (0xa00000) fixed pool (sceKernelCreateFpl named at 0x0000c250, id 0x0000deec), allocates its block (0x0000def0) and builds a heap on it; stores the heap in 0x0000dee0; sets thread attribute 0x4000; runs ui_album_init_render and ui_album_resources_init; enables font shadow and colour codes and sets font flag 1 / trim-wrap-spaces by language (0: flag on, trim off). Returns nothing. Side effects: memory pool, render state, font settings. Exported (libcardalbum_rel); called from rel_story (world_state_start_card_album, mode 1, heap 0), rel_title (ui_title_update_card_album, mode 0, title heap) and rel_labo (0x00000034).

Album state machine on 0x0000c310: 0 waits for the JPEG/cardj setup and the resource loader, builds the list, fades in and hides the loading overlay, state 1; 1 after the fade and 0x21 frames opens the cover and plays menu animation 6, state 2; 2 when the cover is open plays animation 7, puts the cursor on cell 3 and enters browse state 3; 3 browse, 4 page flip, 5 index menu, 6 card viewer; 8 runs ui_album_jpeg_term and ui_album_shutdown_step and returns 1 when both are done. Every state except the finished 8 then runs ui_album_preload_textures. Returns 1 when the album has closed, else 0. Side effects: the whole album. Exported (libcardalbum_rel); called from rel_story (world_state_update_card_album), rel_title (ui_title_update_card_album) and rel_labo (0x00000034).

Shutdown in sub-state 0x0000c312: 0 closes the card view and requests both cip readers to stop; 1 waits until both are idle; 2 frees the pages and resources and, when the album created its own pool, frees and deletes the FPL. Returns 1 when done, else 0. Side effects: frees memory, readers. Callers: 1 (ui_card_album_update, state 8).
